prompt.text:
Implement a CommonJS module exporting exactly `{ authorizePass }`. `authorizePass(request, keys)` validates deterministic HMAC-SHA256 entry passes. A pass is `<base64url JSON>.<lowercase hex signature>`, where the signature covers the base64url segment. The payload must contain non-empty string fields `subject` and `role`, plus an integer `expires`.

`request` has `headers` and an integer `now`; header names are matched case-insensitively. Prefer `x-entry-pass`. If it is absent, `x-renewal-pass` may establish a session. `keys` contains non-empty `entryKey` and `renewalKey` strings.

Return `{ ok: false, status: 401, message: 'Entry pass required' }` when neither pass exists. Malformed payloads, bad signatures, invalid arguments, and unexpired-but-invalid entry passes return the same shape with message `'Invalid entry pass'`. An entry pass is expired when `expires <= request.now`. An expired entry pass may be replaced only by a valid, unexpired renewal pass signed with `renewalKey`. Successful renewal returns `{ ok: true, status: 200, role, renewedPass }`, where `renewedPass` is an entry pass signed with `entryKey`, contains the renewal pass's `subject` and `role`, and expires at `request.now + 300`. A valid entry pass returns `{ ok: true, status: 200, role }`. Failed renewal returns message `'Renewal rejected'`.

Do not mutate any argument. Use only Node.js standard-library modules.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
